comment: Prof. Quirk was an amazing professor and I will miss him.  His classes gave me more information and world knowledge than I could ever have imagined. He will be a very memorable teacher.

Mr. Quirk is simply amazing! His lectures are entertaining and enlightening. There were no tests, only fun and easy group projects. If you put in a good amount of work it is an EASY A. If you're really interested in understanding marketing then the book will help you. However, I got an A in the class and never opened the book once..
Great professor with lots of real world experience to share.  Interesting stories, very helpful and generous.  Lots of class discussion and participation.  Not too much homework.
